segments.sn2.20:1.1: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn2.20:6.2: Idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
segments.sn2.20:7.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn2.20:7.2: “imaṃ, bhikkhave, rattiṃ aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.sn2.20:7.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho, bhikkhave, so devaputto mama santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn2.20:12.2: Idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyī”ti.
segments.sn2.20:13.1: Evaṃ vutte, āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn2.20:13.2: “so hi nūna, bhante, anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhavissati.
segments.sn2.20:13.3: Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmante sāriputte abhippasanno ahosī”ti.
segments.sn2.20:13.4: “Sādhu sādhu, ānanda, yāvatakaṃ kho, ānanda, takkāya pattabbaṃ anuppattaṃ taṃ tayā.
segments.sn2.20:14.1: Candimaso [candimāso (pī. ka.)] ca veṇḍu [veṇhu (sī. ka.)] ca,

lines: Dasame kāmaṃ devatāsaṃyuttepi “idaṃ hi taṃ jetavana”ntiādinā imā eva gāthā āgatā.
Heṭṭhā āgatanayattā eva hi potthakesu na likhitaṃ, idha pana devaputtasaṃyutte “anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto”ti nidāne nigame ca āgataṃ, tattha devaputtena satthu vuttappakāraguṇapavedanavasena vuttaṃ.
Satthā pana bhikkhūnaṃ tamatthaṃ pavedento “aññataro devaputto”ti āha.
